editor_comparison.title: Editor comparison
editor_comparison.intro: Compare the current editor and the Plate prototype. Local edits reset on refresh; joined Plate rooms persist separately from work items.
editor_comparison.replace_note: Loading or copying content replaces the destination editor. Unsupported formatting may be lost; inspect the HTML output before using this for migration.
editor_comparison.error: Content conversion failed. Your source content is still available.
editor_comparison.success: Content updated. Compare the editors and their HTML output.
editor_comparison.scope_note: Compare text formatting, headings, lists and checklists, tables, links, code blocks, colors, alignment, callouts, demo mentions, images and Markdown import. Plate provides a basic slash menu. Emoji search, a floating selection toolbar, block dragging and table merging/splitting are available. Table edge insertion and column resizing are supported. Production assets are not connected. Use the full feature sample and HTML outputs to inspect differences.
editor_comparison.collaboration_note: Join the same workspace, project and room in two browser sessions to collaborate in Plate. Yjs merges concurrent changes; undo affects your edits only. Loading a sample replaces the shared content for everyone. Tiptap and production work item editors remain independent.
editor_comparison.uploadError: Image upload failed. Use an image up to 5 MB.
editor_comparison.unavailable: Image is unavailable in this browser session
editor_comparison.sandbox_note: Local uploads are limited to 5 MB; shared room uploads support PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP. Mentions use demo members and send no notifications.
editor_comparison.roomError: Enter a valid workspace slug, project UUID and room UUID, and sign in.
editor_comparison.roomShare: Share this page URL with another project member to join the same room.
editor_comparison.assetLimit: In a joined room, uploads use the development asset store with project access checks. Local mode keeps images only in this browser session. Production assets remain separate.
